applyTo: "**/*.md"

# Documentation Instructions

- Write documentation in English.
- Keep Android architecture and bring-up notes in `docs/port/`.
- Keep Android build instructions in `docs/BUILD/`.
- Keep user tutorials in `docs/HOWTO/` and update its index.
- Track bugs in `https://github.com/txllthemall/Generals-Mobile/issues`.
- Update `docs/DEV_BLOG/YYYY-MM-DIARY.md` before committing material changes.
- Do not restore archived desktop-port plans, reports or platform guides.
- Distinguish CI/build validation from tests performed on a physical device.
